_about: Scoring rules for the DROUGHT, HEAT and FIRE badges. Each rule adds points; the total decides the level. Edit numbers here, no code change needed. Reload the page to apply.

trend._about: Linear regression over the 20 full years. A trend counts as increasing/decreasing only if the change per decade is at least the 'stable' limit below; 'significant' means the slope passes a t-test.

currentYear._about: The current year is partial, so it is compared with the 20-year average of the same months.

levels._about: Total points needed for each level (below 'medium' is low).

heat._about: A month is 'hot' when its T2M_MAX is at least hotMonthMarginC above the 20-year average for that calendar month. Counted over the last 12 months with data.

fire._about: NASA FIRMS detections in the last 'days' days. 'radiusKm' is the search distance from the field centre; 'nearKm' counts as close to the field.
